title: Panel clips content taller than itself, with no scrollbar and no way to reach it by mouse
foundBy: user report (repository owner): "the Explorer - Sectioned Tree entries are not scrolling for me"
details:
Panel's body carries `overflow: hidden`. Content taller than the Panel is therefore clipped with no scrollbar, and Panel exposes `width` and nothing for height or scrolling, so a consumer cannot ask for anything else without overriding internals.

Measured in the Explorer pattern with Playwright. The Panel body is 408px tall around 2109px of content, so 1701px of a 65 row tree is off screen. A real wheel gesture over the tree moves nothing: no box inside the card changes `scrollTop`, and the window does not move either.

The content is not gone, which is what makes this hard to see. A box with `overflow: hidden` still scrolls programmatically, so `scrollIntoView` on the last row takes the body's `scrollTop` from 0 to 1685 and brings it into view. Keyboard navigation and any link-driven selection therefore work, and only the mouse fails. That is the input-method-dependent content loss one of the original consumer reports described, except here it is the kit's own component doing the clipping rather than a consumer's override.

Two faults, and they are separable. Panel losing content silently is the component fault and the one to fix: either the body scrolls when it overflows, or Panel gains a prop that says what to do, but clipping without a scrollbar should not be the default. The Explorer pattern composing an unbounded SectionedTree inside a fixed height Panel is the second, and patterns are the worked examples people copy, so it currently teaches the broken composition.

Deciding this properly means deciding CUI-011 with it. A content-height mode on Tree and Panel is the other half of the same question.

notes.text: Pre-existing, not introduced by the Tree work. The whole ancestor chain from the deepest row to the body was captured on this branch and on a build of main, and the two are identical: the Panel body reports client 408 and scroll 2109 with overflow hidden in both, and the wheel moves nothing in both.
Not fixed here. Making Panel's body scroll changes the layout of every Panel in every consumer, so it is the repository owner's call rather than a fix to slip into a Tree change.
